---
title: "Git"
---

Keep the file on disk while removing it from Git tracking. (Git 2.43.0)

```bash
git rm --cached <file>
```

Undo the most recent unpushed commit while keeping changes staged. (Git 2.43.0)

```bash
git reset --soft HEAD~1
```

Create and push an annotated tag. (Git 2.43.0)

```bash
git tag -a v2026.08.21 -m "v2026.08.21"
git push origin --tags
```

Restore `smk/readme_eval.md` from a remote branch into the current working tree. (Git 2.43.0)

```bash
git restore --source=remotes/origin/64-viirs-prewarp-blocks -- smk/readme_eval.md
```

List local and remote branches. (Git 2.43.0)

```bash
git branch -a
```

Merge without committing, then abort if needed; a fast-forward creates no merge commit. (Git 2.43.0)

```bash
git merge --no-commit <branch>
git merge --abort
```

Apply a specific commit to the current branch. (Git 2.43.0)

```bash
git cherry-pick 1dd0d9bd9e50e41e6d9d7dfc25326155cbb77800
```
